nodes.name: tokens.css
nodes.summary: Design System source of truth defining canonical CSS custom properties: brand colors, semantic color aliases, typography font stacks, border radii, spacing scale, and layout max-widths used across the frontend.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a two-tier variable pattern: raw brand values (--brand-orange, --brand-ink) feed semantic aliases (--color-action-primary-bg) so components reference intent rather than raw color.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet imported by the app entry point that resets box-sizing and base element styles, applies the brand background/text/font tokens to body, and defines a focus-visible outline using the brand yellow accent.

nodes.name: typography.css
nodes.summary: Typography rules for headings, paragraphs, and links, applying the Rye display font to headings and the terracotta brand color, with spacing driven by the design token scale.
